query.description: One search term, as you would type it into Mercado Livre's search box
query.title: maxLength(120)

limit.description: The most results to return in this call, 1 to 50. Default 20.
limit.title: between(1, 50)

cursor.description: The next_cursor a previous call returned, to get the results that follow. Send the same other inputs as that call; limit may change.
cursor.title: maxLength(2048)

Trimmed.description: a string with no leading or trailing whitespace
Trimmed.title: trimmed

applied_query.description: The search term the results page says it searched
applied_query.title: nonEmptyString

query_corrected.description: True when the site searched a different term than the one sent, such as a corrected spelling

item_id.description: The listing's item ID as Mercado Livre shows it, such as MLB1234567890; for a catalog product card that names no single listing (several sellers), the catalog product ID, such as MLB79456482

title.description: The product title as the result card shows it
title.title: nonEmptyString

price.description: Current price in BRL (reais) as a number, such as 122.5 for R$ 122,50
price.title: nonNegative

previous_price.description: The previous (crossed-out) price in BRL as a number; null when the card shows none

discount_percent.description: The discount the card shows, in percent (18 for "18% OFF"); null when it shows none

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the prices, always BRL on this site

free_shipping.description: True when the card's shipping line offers free shipping (grátis), such as "Chegará grátis amanhã"

shipping_label.description: The card's shipping line as shown, such as "Chegará grátis hoje"; null when the card shows none

sponsored.description: True when the card is an ad (Patrocinado)

url.description: The product page URL without tracking parameters. For sponsored cards, whose only link is an ad click-tracking redirect, this is the site's item link https://produto.mercadolivre.com.br/MLB-<id>, which opens the same product page

image_url.description: URL of the card's main product image

rating.description: Average customer rating out of 5 as the card shows it; null when the card shows none

seller.description: The seller or official store line the card shows, such as "JBL"; null when the card shows none

results.description: Products in the site's order, sponsored ones in place

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same inputs, to get the results that follow. Null when no more can be fetched.

next_cursor_expires_at.description: When next_cursor stops working, as an ISO 8601 UTC time; null when next_cursor is null.

has_more.description: Whether the site shows more results after these, reachable or not.

total_results.description: The site's own exact count of results; null when it shows none or only an approximate one.

list_changed.description: True when the site's list changed since the cursor was issued, and on every later page once rows returned before can come back; rows may be missing or repeated relative to earlier pages, so de-duplicate by key.

next_cursor_unavailable.description: Why next_cursor is null although has_more is true: depth_cap past the deepest page this tool can reach again, no_progress when this call returned no results and could not move past the cursor's position, or the run's time stopped it there twice in a row, position_too_long when the site's link to the next page is too long for a cursor, off_site when it leaves the site, or the host could not sign one.
